title: Proper rational sections, semilinear iterates and moving-point square data
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a proper $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], a prime $\ell\ne p$ and a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in the rational constructible category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $a:Y\to s$, $g=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times h$, where $h$ is the point Frobenius isomorphism [def-weil-frobenius-detailed, def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. Use derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and their specified compositors [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition]. Define $C_E=\operatorname{Fib}_s\circ Ra_!$ at the identity compactification and $\operatorname{Fib}_{z,E}=\operatorname{Fib}_s\circ Lz^*$ for every $z:s\to Y$ [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology, def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. For $r\ge1$, put $P_r=L(g^r)^*$ and use the specified compact transport $\tau_M:C_E(M)\to C_E(Lg^*M)$ [def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport]. The contracted iterates are the recursion $\tau_M^{[1]}=\tau_M$ and
$$\tau_M^{[r+1]}=C_E(c_{g^r,g,M}^{-1})\circ\tau_{Lg^*M}^{[r]}\circ\tau_M,$$
where $c_{g^r,g,M}:L(g^{r+1})^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}L(g^r)^*Lg^*M$ is the specified pullback compositor (the convention for positive powers is [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]). For a section $z$ of $a$, let $z_r=g^rzh^{-r}$ be the moving point of [def-a1-proper-sections-germ-and-moving-point]. Its defining identities are $az_r=\operatorname{id}_s$ and $z_rh^r=g^rz$. Define
$$b_{r,z,M}:(h^r)^*z_r^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}z^*(g^r)^*M$$
by the inverse compositor for $(h^r,z_r)$, the equality $z_rh^r=g^rz$, and the compositor for $(z,g^r)$, in this order. Finally, for an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and finite intermediate field $F$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], define the stage realization $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(F)\to D(\Omega)$ by inclusion into $D(F)$ and the canonical exact scalar-and-size extension along the actual embedding $F\hookrightarrow\Omega$ [def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport]. The scheme and closure universes are independent. These are the specified functors, iterated maps, square comparisons and realization, without asserting the semilinear counit-germ identity.

    (r : ℕ) → (rationalSections D Y₀ l E).obj M ⟶
      (rationalSections D Y₀ l E).obj

          (localPositivePower (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom r)).obj M)
